card.label: Dictionary lookup
card.sampleNoMatch: The built-in samples cover subtle, yield, record, ran, run, play, and take off.
audio.failed: Could not load the audio. Select Play to try again.
error.generic: Could not look up the text.
error.missingKey: Choose an API key in the Palimserest settings.
error.connection: Could not connect to the dictionary.
error.rejectedKey: The dictionary rejected the request. Check your API key.
error.rateLimit: The dictionary request limit has been reached. Try again later.
error.invalidResponse: Could not read the dictionary response.
settings.intro: Set the {property} property to true on a note. Click a highlighted word to look it up. Hover over selected text to show a lookup button.
settings.requests.label: Dictionary requests today
settings.requests.description: Counts online lookup requests sent from this vault on the local date. Cache hits, offline samples, and audio playback are excluded.
settings.provider.label: Dictionary source
settings.provider.description: Try the built-in samples offline. Select Merriam-Webster once you have permission to use its dictionary API.
settings.secret.label: Learner’s Dictionary API key
settings.secret.description: Choose your key from Obsidian's secret storage. Online lookups send the queried text and key to Merriam-Webster.
settings.hoverStyle.label: Hover style
settings.hoverStyle.description: How a word is marked when it becomes clickable for lookup.
settings.hoverDelay.label: Hover delay (ms)
settings.hoverDelay.description: How long to hover before a word highlights or a selection shows a lookup button.
settings.maxSenses.label: Definition limit
settings.maxSenses.description: Maximum number of definitions displayed for one lookup.
settings.maxWordLength.label: Word length limit
settings.maxWordLength.description: Only words up to this length are eligible for lookup.
settings.maxSelectionLength.label: Selection length limit
settings.maxSelectionLength.description: Maximum number of characters in a selection eligible for lookup.
settings.selectionExitDelay.label: Selection button hide delay (ms)
settings.selectionExitDelay.description: How long the lookup button stays visible while moving the mouse from the selection to the button.
settings.loadingDelay.label: Loading indicator delay (ms)
settings.loadingDelay.description: How long to wait after a click before showing the loading skeleton.
settings.requestTimeout.label: Request timeout (ms)
settings.requestTimeout.description: Maximum wait for each dictionary request.
settings.autoRetries.label: Automatic retries
settings.autoRetries.description: Extra attempts after a network error, timeout, or dictionary service error. Set to 0 to disable automatic retries.
settings.retryDelay.label: Retry delay (ms)
settings.retryDelay.description: How long to wait before each automatic retry.
settings.cacheLimit.label: Cache entry limit
settings.cacheLimit.description: Maximum number of online lookup results stored for this vault. Set to 0 to disable the cache.
settings.cacheMaxAgeHours.label: Cache lifetime (hours)
settings.cacheMaxAgeHours.description: How long to keep a result after its lookup finishes. Set to 0 to disable the cache.
